summary: The inbox root and consumed/ paths are spelled in three packages: core/ship_recovery_unwind.go (inboxRoot, consumedInbox), explanationdocs/rebind.go (the same two constants, added by Q12, because core imports explanationdocs) and phases/ship/consume.go (inboxRel, consumedRel without the trailing slash).
